title: dorieh
description: Dorieh is a data engineering platform for population and environmental health research. It turns heterogeneous raw sources, including Medicare and Medicaid claims in fixed-width ResDAC layouts and climate and air-quality data, into documented, queryable warehouses: schema-driven ingestion through a domain-specific language, CWL-orchestrated workflows, data validation and journaling, quality-control aggregates, and column-level provenance. The platform's methodology is described in the monograph "Research Data that Can be Trusted" (Springer, 2026, doi:10.1007/978-3-032-21032-6), which is the preferred citation for the methodology; cite this record for the software itself.
